name: composition-browser-mutation
js: const t=editorTest; t.load(); t.editor.open(t.controller.blocks[0].key,0); const el=document.querySelector('[data-role=block-editor]'); t.select(4); const g=t.controller.doc.generation, n=t.editor.restyles; el.dispatchEvent(new CompositionEvent('compositionstart',{bubbles:true})); document.execCommand('insertText',false,'*'); if(t.controller.doc.generation!==g||t.editor.restyles!==n)throw Error('Composition changed application state'); const held=!!t.controller.doc.heldRange(Date.now()+10000); el.dispatchEvent(new CompositionEvent('compositionend',{bubbles:true})); if(t.controller.doc.generation!==g+1||!held)throw Error('Composition did not commit'); return {applicationRestylesDuringComposition:0,held,exact:t.check()}

hold-agent-scroll
js: const t=editorTest;t.load(); const b=t.controller.blocks[35];t.editor.open(b.key,3);document.execCommand('insertText',false,'x');await t.frames();const el=document.querySelector('[data-role=block-editor]');el.scrollIntoView();scrollBy(0,100);const node=el.firstChild,html=el.innerHTML,selection=getSelection().toString(),top=el.getBoundingClientRect().top;const held=t.controller.doc.heldRange();const generation=t.controller.doc.generation;t.host.emit('agentApply',{operationId:'held',baseGeneration:generation,edits:[{start:held.start,end:held.start+1,text:'!',expected:t.controller.doc.source.slice(held.start,held.start+1)}]});if(t.controller.doc.generation!==generation)throw Error('Agent changed held range');const head=t.controller.blocks[0],old=t.controller.doc.source.slice(head.start,head.end);t.host.emit('agentApply',{operationId:'above',baseGeneration:generation,edits:[{start:head.start,end:head.end,text:old+'\r\n'+('taller line\r\n').repeat(8),expected:old}]});await t.frames();const drift=el.getBoundingClientRect().top-top;const unchanged=el.firstChild===node&&el.innerHTML===html&&getSelection().toString()===selection;if(Math.abs(drift)>.5||!unchanged)throw Error(JSON.stringify({drift,unchanged}));return {heldRefused:true,anchorDrift:drift,activeDOMUnchanged:unchanged,exact:t.check()}
